about_the_game:
Free Build, Infinite Possibilities

Equip unique skill runes and freely combine active abilities with support effects. Grow through a simple yet distinctive talent system, and craft your unique combat style by pairing skill runes with talents. Will you become a berserk warrior or a mysterious warlock? The choice is yours.

Rune Words, Legendary Forging

Collect ancient runes and inlay them into base gear following mystical combinations to activate powerful Rune Word effects. Each crafted item brings transformative upgrades, from basic stats to special affixes, forging your ultimate endgame gear.

Ultimate Loot, Thrilling Combat

Challenge randomly generated dark dungeons, face hordes of monsters, and battle elite bosses with deadly threats. Diverse loot drops await, from common whites to rare uniques—every fight could yield a game-changing core item.

Fast-Paced Combat, Strategy & Skill

A fluid ARPG combat system blends movement skills and precise positioning, making every battle exhilarating yet tactical. Boss fights feature intricate designs, multi-phase transformations, and unique mechanics to test your build and reflexes.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.
